mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of a custom carport in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a custom carport in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex is primarily influenced by its size, materials, roof style, foundation requirements, and any integrated features like lighting or additional storage. For instance, a carport constructed with premium materials and custom design elements will naturally involve a greater investment than a basic structure.
